$comment: Peoples and traits (docs/proposals/phase-peoples-and-traits.md). Every colonist and village belongs to one people; villages keep to one. Traits are personal (at most two) and children may inherit them. All effects are read through peoples.js.

people.name: Hearthfolk
people.about: Settled farming folk of the open grasslands: the people of every classic village.

people.name: Reedkin
people.about: Small, slight people of marshes and riverbanks: thirsty but light eaters, patient growers and cooks, slow to anger.

people.name: Cragborn
people.about: Tall, broad people of hills and snowfields: big eaters who shrug off the cold, born miners and builders, proud and quick to feud.

people.name: Duneshade
people.about: Lean people of the sands: they need little water and walk far, skilled crafters, but the cold reaches them early.

trait.name: Brave
trait.about: Fights on while badly hurt, fends off wolves when wounded and is first to join a hunt party.

trait.name: Timid
trait.about: Never joins a fight or a hunt party unless cornered, and flees danger from farther away.

trait.name: Hardy
trait.about: Illness takes a lighter hold, wounds heal faster and the cold comes later.

trait.name: Sickly
trait.about: Catches illness more easily, suffers it worse and heals slowly.

trait.name: Wise
trait.about: Learns every skill half again as fast.

trait.name: Diligent
trait.about: Works a tenth faster at everything.

trait.name: Lazy
trait.about: Works a tenth slower and tires a little sooner.

trait.name: Greedy
trait.about: Eats a tenth more; their village drives a harder bargain (3% a greedy adult, at most 15%).

trait.name: Strong
trait.about: Mines, chops and builds a tenth faster.

trait.name: Kind
trait.about: Tends and treats the sick and hurt a third faster.
